## Description and Rationale

I am an independent participant with a background in civil engineering and a growing focus on AI, machine learning, and LLM engineering. I decided to register for the PRC Data Challenge 2026 because I want to apply my machine learning skills to a real-world problem outside my usual domain and learn from working with open aviation data. I am particularly interested in developing a strong, reproducible solution to the taxi-out time prediction problem and sharing the code and methodology openly as part of the challenge's open-science goals.
